newsitem.title: USA: Strategic Minerals names new vanadium officials.
newsitem.headline: Strategic Minerals names new vanadium officials.

text.p: Strategic Minerals Corp, one of the world's biggest vanadium producers, said it appointed Hein Enslin to be president of its subsidiary U.S. Vanadium Corp, and will also become vice president of the parent company.
Daniel Harris has been appointed managing director of Vametco Minerals, the South Africa-based subsidiary which produces ferro-vanadium.

William Curran, formerly president of U.S. Vanadium Corp, will continue as corporate vice president but will assume responsibility for business development, employee relations and worldwide marketing.
Connecticut-based Stratcor has operations in South Africa, U.S., and a joint venture in Europe.
